description: This file contains multiple Orleans grain classes used for persistent state testing, including grains with different key types and generic grains. It defines grains that interact with persistent state storage, perform read/write/delete operations, and expose state data.

classes.name: GrainStorageTestGrain
classes.description: A grain class for testing persistent state with simple integer field and basic operations.

classes.name: GrainStorageTestGrainExtendedKey
classes.description: A grain class with extended key support, providing access to the key value.

classes.name: GrainStorageGenericGrain`1
classes.description: A generic grain class parallel to the above, handling a generic type field in persistent state.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of the grain's persisted state field.

methods.name: DoWrite
methods.description: Writes a value to the persisted state and saves it.

methods.name: GetStateAsync
methods.description: Returns the current grain state along with metadata.

methods.name: GetExtendedKeyValue
methods.description: Retrieves the extended key of the grain instance.
